page.notes: The brace groups (Ruben to Iuda, Naphthali to Dina) are rendered as plain lines; the brace itself is not reproduced. The Greek in 2158 is uncertain: the second word and the final letters of both words are read with doubt, and the accents may differ from the print. The year 2196 and 2197 appear twice in the scan's order, as printed; the marginal line numbers at 5 to 35 are part of the printed page. Left-edge marks belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted.
